understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level, completing the current BP35 level and continuing until the game is won.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: The player moves on a tile grid using directional actions. With gravity DOWN, the player falls downward when possible. Clicking a tile can remove it and may cause the player to fall or move through the resulting opening. Directional movement changes position only when the destination is available; repeated moves may have no effect. Spike tiles are hazards that end the attempt if landed on. Each level provides two attempts of up to 50 turns, and a failed attempt restarts the level. Undo can be used to reverse an action when available.
